q: Obuto bwa William Booth bwali butya, era bwamukola butya?
a: Booth yazaalibwa mu 1829 mu Sneinton, ku lubalama lwa Nottingham, era yakulira ng'atunuulira amaka ge nga gava mu bulamu obw'ekigero ne gagwa mu bwavu obw'amazima. Ng'aweza emyaka kkumi n'esatu yateekebwa okuyigirira ewa nannyini katale k'ebbanja, ng'amala ennaku ze emabega w'emmeeza abaavu gye baawanyisizanga ekyasembayo ku bintu byabwe olw'essiringi ntono. Okuyigirizibwa okwo okw'olubereberye okutayinza kwerabirwa ku ebyo obwavu bye bukola ku bantu kwe kwafuuka ensulo y'omulimu gw'obulamu bwe mu baavu ennyo.

q: Booth yajja atya mu kukkiriza, era yamalirira ki ng'akyuse?
a: Yakyusibwa mu 1844, ng'aweza emyaka kkumi n'etaano, oluvannyuma lw'okugenda mu Wesley Chapel mu Nottingham, era ng'ennyinyonnyola ye bwe yali, ekifo ekyakyusa kyali okuzzaawo enkizo entono etaali ya bwesimbu gye yali afunye ng'akyali mulenzi. Okuva mu kubala okwo okw'omutima ne wazaalibwa okumalirira kwe yakuuma obulamu bwe bwonna: nti Katonda afune si kitundu kye wabula ye yenna. Yakiteeka mu sentensi emu gye yatalekangayo: "Katonda ajja kufuna byonna ebiri mu William Booth."

q: Catherine Booth yali ani, era lwaki ayitibwa omu ku batandisi b'Eggye ery'Obulokozi?
a: Catherine Mumford yasisinkana William mu 1852 n'amufumbirwa mu 1855, era mu ye yasangamu si mukyala kyokka wabula mukozi munne ow'okukakasa okw'ekitalo. Yakkiriza nti omukazi asobola okubuulira mu mazima nga bw'akola omusajja, era okukakasa okwo kwakola ku kibiina kye baazimba wamu, abakazi mwe baasobolera okubuulira n'okukulembera. Ng'amanyiddwa nga Nnyina w'Eggye ery'Obulokozi, yali ayenkanankana n'obunyiikivu bwa William n'obwongo obunywevu obw'eby'okutegeera Katonda, era amaka gaabwe ne gafuuka ensigo y'omulimu, abamu ku baana baabwe munaana ne bakula ne bagukulembera.

q: Obuweereza obw'omu buvanjuba bwa London bwafuuka butya Eggye ery'Obulokozi?
a: Mu 1865 Booth yali abuulira mu weema ku malaalo ga Whitechapel bwe yawulira ng'azudde omulimu gw'obulamu bwe mu baavu ab'omu kitundu ky'ebuvanjuba bwa London, era n'atandikawo ekyafuuka Christian Mission (Obuweereza obw'Ekikristaayo). Mu 1878, bwe yali awandiisa alipoota eyayogera ku Buweereza nga "eggye ery'okwewaayo," ebigambo ebyo ne bisangulwa era "Eggye ery'Obulokozi" ne kiwandiikibwa mu kifo kyabyo. Okukyusibwa kw'ekigambo kimu ne kikyusa buli kimu ku ngeri ekibiina gye kyeyalabamu.

q: Lwaki Eggye ery'Obulokozi lyatwala ebifo eby'obuserikale, yunifoomu, n'ebidongo eby'ekikomo?
a: Erinnya bwe lyakyuka, n'enteekateeka n'egoberera: Booth yafuuka Jenerali waalyo, era abakozi be ne batwala ebifo eby'obuserikale nga bakungu n'abaserikale, ne bambala yunifoomu, ne batambulira emabega w'ebidongo eby'ekikomo. Mu bugenderevu baateeka ebigambo eby'Ekikristaayo ku nnyimba ez'omu mayumba g'omwenge. Byonna byali biteekeddwateekeddwa okutuuka ku bantu ekkanisa ey'ekitiibwa gye teyasobola kutuukako, era ku nkomerero y'obulamu bwa Booth Eggye lyali likola mu mawanga amakumi ataano mu munaana.

q: Booth yali ategeeza ki bwe yagatta omulimu gw'embeera z'abantu n'okubuulira?
a: Booth yagaana okwawula okulokola emyoyo n'okuliisa emibiri, okwewaayo okwatera okufunzibwa mu bigambo "ssupu, ssabbuuni, n'obulokozi." Eggye lyaddukanya obuddukiro eri abataliiko maka, ebifo eby'okugabiramu ssupu, obujjanjabi eri abaasibibwa omwenge, amaka eri abasibe abaateebwa, obuyambi obw'amateeka, n'ebifo by'obujjanjabi. Nga bwe yakyogera: "Toyinza kwokya mitima gy'abantu n'okwagala kwa Katonda bwe baba n'olubuto olwereere n'ebigere ebinnyogovu."

q: Ddala Eggye ery'Obulokozi ery'olubereberye lyalumbibwa mu nguudo?
a: Yee, era emirundi mingi n'obukambwe. Eby'obusuubuzi bw'omwenge, ebyatiisibwa okuziyiza kwa Booth omwenge, byakubiriza ekyayitibwa Eggye ery'Amagumba, eryamenya ennyiriri z'Eggye ery'Obulokozi n'enkonde n'amayinja, era mu 1882 abantu b'Eggye ery'Obulokozi ebikumi baalumbibwa, mu bo nga mwe muli abakazi n'abaana bangi. Booth yayolekera okulumbibwa nga bwe yayolekera buli kimu — ng'afukamidde, oluvannyuma n'addamu okuyimirira ku bigere bye — ng'akakasa nti enkola ezo ze zokka ezaali eziyinza okutuuka ku bantu abataali bagenda kuyingira kkanisa.

q: "In Darkest England and the Way Out" kye ki?
a: Kye kiwandiiko ekyatundibwa ennyo Booth kye yafulumya mu 1890, ekyateekawo omusingi gw'omulimu omunene ogw'embeera z'abantu ogw'Eggye: obuddukiro, ebisaakaate by'ennimiro, n'obujjanjabi. Ekitabo kyawakanira okukola ku nsonga ezireeta obwavu obw'amaanyi mu abo ab'omulembe ogwo be baayita "ekitundu eky'ekkumi ekyabbira," era kyayamba okukyusa endowooza y'abantu ku bwavu bwennyini. Obuyinza bwakyo bwatuuka wala okusukka Eggye, ne bureka akabonero ku ntambula ez'enkyukakyuka mu mbeera z'abantu ezaaddirira.

q: Booth yali atwalibwa atya we yafiira mu 1912?
a: Omusajja eyali avumiddwa nga mulimba, era Lord Shaftesbury n'amuyita "Omulabe wa Kristo," yakomekkereza obulamu bwe ng'omuntu w'eggwanga assibwamu ekitiibwa ennyo, ng'aweereddwa diguli ey'ekitiibwa e Oxford era ng'afuuliddwa omutuuze ow'eddembe ow'Ekibuga London. Yeeyongera okubuulira mu bukadde, nga muzibe w'eriiso limu, era mu Royal Albert Hall mu 1912 n'alayira nti: "Ng'abakazi bakaaba, nga bwe bakola kaakano, nnaalwana ... nnaalwana okutuusa ku nkomerero ddala." Bwe "yayimusibwa okugenda mu Kitiibwa," mu kigambo ky'Eggye, nga 20 Agusito 1912, abantu nga 150,000 baayita nga balaba essanduuko ye, era obubaka bwe obusembayo eri Eggye lye kigambibwa nti bwali kigambo kimu kyokka: "Abalala."
